f keys and meanings:
- distance: current-to-candidate (lower = better)
- return_distance: candidate-to-start (lower = better, only matters near end)
- nearest_remaining: nearest other unvisited distance (lower = candidate is in dense area = good)
- mean_remaining: mean distance to others (lower = candidate is central = good)
- regret: second-nearest minus nearest among other unvisited nodes (higher = more "urgent" to pick this candidate next)
- progress: visited fraction (higher = later in tour)
- cluster_density: fraction of other unvisited cities within mean distance (higher = denser cluster = good for picking)
- spread: std of candidate-to-unvisited distances (higher = more varied)
